javascript: Optional. With data-ggds-module="error-summary", the GGDS script moves focus to the summary when the page loads, and each link moves focus to its field and scrolls its label or question into view.
classes: The box, with a thick red border. Give it role="alert", aria-labelledby (its title) and tabindex="-1".
One link per problem, each to its field.
states: Focused when the page loads (with the GGDS script).
django:
{# Automatic with {{ form }} and GGDSFormRenderer; on its own: #}
{% ggds_error_summary form %}
tests: error summary takes focus on load
after a failed submit the error summary is read first, and its links reach each field
